home.languagesText: We translate into Russian from 14 languages:

1.title: Choose services
1.text: Add services to your cart and specify the language of your document.

2.title: Choose a location
2.text: Select the nearest drop-off point in Kazan.

3.title: Attach files and pay
3.text: A photo or scan from your phone is enough. Pay by SBP, QR code or card.

4.title: Get your result
4.text: We will notify you when it's ready. Pick it up at the selected location.

price.q: How much does it cost to translate one page?
price.a: Legal and medical documents — 550 ₽ per page, technical documentation — 650 ₽. Passport, diploma and certificate translations have fixed prices listed in the catalog.

time.q: How quickly will the translation be ready?
time.a: The standard time is 1–2 business days. Urgent: within 1 day (×1.5) or on the same day (×2).

notary.a: Yes. Services marked «notarized» already include notarization; for other translations you can add it in the cart.

languages.q: Which languages do you translate from?
languages.a: From Turkmen, Uzbek, Turkish, Azerbaijani, Kazakh, Kyrgyz, Persian (Farsi), Arabic (Iraq, Syria), English, German, French, Spanish and Italian — into Russian.

status.q: How can I track my order status?
status.a: Use your order number and phone number on the «Order status» page, in your account or in Telegram.

where.a: We have three drop-off points in Kazan: Sibirsky Trakt St., 7/6; Karla Marksa St., 65; Promyslovaya St., 5, office 3.
